title: Japanese: N5 Kanji (80)
description: For beginning Japanese learners: 80 common kanji often studied toward N5, with selected on/kun readings and example words. JLPT does not publish an official kanji list.

cards.back: one. On: ichi, itsu. Kun: hito, hitotsu. Example: 一つ (hitotsu): one item.
two. On: ni. Kun: futa, futatsu. Example: 二月 (nigatsu): February.
three. On: san. Kun: mi, mittsu. Example: 三つ (mittsu): three items.
four. On: shi. Kun: yo, yon, yottsu. Example: 四月 (shigatsu): April.
five. On: go. Kun: itsu, itsutsu. Example: 五日 (itsuka): fifth day of the month.
cards.example: 五日 (itsuka): fifth day of the month

cards.back: six. On: roku. Kun: mu, muttsu. Example: 六つ (muttsu): six items.
seven. On: shichi. Kun: nana, nanatsu. Example: 七月 (shichigatsu): July.
eight. On: hachi. Kun: ya, yattsu. Example: 八つ (yattsu): eight items.
nine. On: kyuu, ku. Kun: kokono, kokonotsu. Example: 九月 (kugatsu): September.
ten. On: juu, ji. Kun: too, to. Example: 十日 (tooka): tenth day of the month.
cards.example: 十日 (tooka): tenth day of the month

cards.back: hundred. On: hyaku. Kun: not commonly used. Example: 百円 (hyakuen): one hundred yen.
thousand. On: sen. Kun: chi. Example: 千円 (sen'en): one thousand yen.
ten thousand. On: man, ban. Kun: not commonly used. Example: 一万円 (ichiman'en): ten thousand yen.
yen; circle. On: en. Kun: marui. Example: 円 (en): yen.
day; sun. On: nichi, jitsu. Kun: hi, ka. Example: 日曜日 (nichiyoubi): Sunday.
month; moon. On: getsu, gatsu. Kun: tsuki. Example: 月曜日 (getsuyoubi): Monday.
fire. On: ka. Kun: hi, ho. Example: 火曜日 (kayoubi): Tuesday.
water. On: sui. Kun: mizu. Example: 水曜日 (suiyoubi): Wednesday.
tree; wood. On: moku, boku. Kun: ki, ko. Example: 木曜日 (mokuyoubi): Thursday.
gold; money. On: kin, kon. Kun: kane, kana. Example: 金曜日 (kin'youbi): Friday.
earth; soil. On: do, to. Kun: tsuchi. Example: 土曜日 (doyoubi): Saturday.
day of the week. On: you. Kun: not commonly used. Example: 曜日 (youbi): day of the week.
cards.example: 曜日 (youbi): day of the week
cards.hint: Think of the kanji shared by weekday names.

cards.back: year. On: nen. Kun: toshi. Example: 今年 (kotoshi): this year.
time; hour. On: ji. Kun: toki. Example: 時間 (jikan): time.
part; minute. On: bun, fun, bu. Kun: wakaru, wakeru. Example: 五分 (gofun): five minutes.
half. On: han. Kun: nakaba. Example: 半分 (hanbun): half.
now. On: kon, kin. Kun: ima. Example: 今月 (kongetsu): this month.
what. On: ka. Kun: nani, nan. Example: 何時 (nanji): what time.
person. On: jin, nin. Kun: hito. Example: 日本人 (nihonjin): Japanese person.
man; male. On: dan, nan. Kun: otoko. Example: 男の子 (otokonoko): boy.
woman; female. On: jo, nyo. Kun: onna, me. Example: 女の子 (onnanoko): girl.
child. On: shi, su. Kun: ko. Example: 子ども (kodomo): child.
mother. On: bo. Kun: haha. Example: 母 (haha): my mother.
father. On: fu. Kun: chichi. Example: 父 (chichi): my father.
friend. On: yuu. Kun: tomo. Example: 友だち (tomodachi): friend.
ahead; previous. On: sen. Kun: saki. Example: 先生 (sensei): teacher.
life; birth. On: sei, shou. Kun: ikiru, umareru, nama. Example: 学生 (gakusei): student.
study; learning. On: gaku. Kun: manabu. Example: 学校 (gakkou): school.
school. On: kou. Kun: not commonly used. Example: 高校 (koukou): high school.
book; origin. On: hon. Kun: moto. Example: 本屋 (hon'ya): bookstore.
language; word. On: go. Kun: kataru. Example: 日本語 (nihongo): Japanese language.
writing; sentence. On: bun, mon. Kun: fumi. Example: 作文 (sakubun): composition.
character; letter. On: ji. Kun: aza. Example: 漢字 (kanji): Chinese character used in Japanese.
cards.example: 漢字 (kanji): Chinese character used in Japanese

cards.back: name. On: mei, myou. Kun: na. Example: 名前 (namae): name.
big. On: dai, tai. Kun: ookii. Example: 大学 (daigaku): university.
small. On: shou. Kun: chiisai, ko, o. Example: 小学校 (shougakkou): elementary school.
middle; inside. On: chuu, juu. Kun: naka. Example: 中学校 (chuugakkou): junior high school.
up; above. On: jou. Kun: ue, agaru, noboru. Example: 上 (ue): above.
down; below. On: ka, ge. Kun: shita, sagaru, kudaru. Example: 下 (shita): below.
left. On: sa. Kun: hidari. Example: 左手 (hidarite): left hand.
right. On: u, yuu. Kun: migi. Example: 右手 (migite): right hand.
before; front. On: zen. Kun: mae. Example: 午前 (gozen): morning; a.m..
after; behind. On: go, kou. Kun: ato, ushiro, nochi. Example: 午後 (gogo): afternoon; p.m..
outside. On: gai, ge. Kun: soto, hazusu. Example: 外国 (gaikoku): foreign country.
east. On: tou. Kun: higashi. Example: 東京 (toukyou): Tokyo.
west. On: sei, sai. Kun: nishi. Example: 西口 (nishiguchi): west exit.
south. On: nan. Kun: minami. Example: 南口 (minamiguchi): south exit.
north. On: hoku. Kun: kita. Example: 北口 (kitaguchi): north exit.
mountain. On: san. Kun: yama. Example: 山 (yama): mountain.
river. On: sen. Kun: kawa. Example: 川 (kawa): river.
rice field. On: den. Kun: ta. Example: 田んぼ (tanbo): rice paddy.
heaven; sky. On: ten. Kun: ame, ama. Example: 天気 (tenki): weather.
spirit; energy. On: ki, ke. Kun: not commonly used. Example: 元気 (genki): well; energetic.
rain. On: u. Kun: ame, ama. Example: 雨 (ame): rain.
electricity. On: den. Kun: not commonly used. Example: 電話 (denwa): telephone.
vehicle. On: sha. Kun: kuruma. Example: 電車 (densha): train.
station. On: eki. Kun: not commonly used. Example: 駅 (eki): train station.
cards.hint: A place where a train stops.

cards.back: road; way. On: dou. Kun: michi. Example: 道 (michi): road.
country. On: koku. Kun: kuni. Example: 外国人 (gaikokujin): foreigner.
white. On: haku, byaku. Kun: shiro, shiroi. Example: 白い (shiroi): white.
high; expensive. On: kou. Kun: takai. Example: 高い (takai): high; expensive.
inexpensive; peaceful. On: an. Kun: yasui. Example: 安い (yasui): inexpensive.
new. On: shin. Kun: atarashii, ara, nii. Example: 新聞 (shinbun): newspaper.
old. On: ko. Kun: furui. Example: 古い (furui): old.
long; chief. On: chou. Kun: nagai. Example: 長い (nagai): long.
many. On: ta. Kun: ooi. Example: 多い (ooi): many.
few; little. On: shou. Kun: sukunai, sukoshi. Example: 少し (sukoshi): a little.
go. On: kou, gyou. Kun: iku, yuku, okonau. Example: 銀行 (ginkou): bank.
come. On: rai. Kun: kuru, kitaru. Example: 来年 (rainen): next year.
see. On: ken. Kun: miru, mieru. Example: 見る (miru): to see.
